The machine description does not explicitly state that the charts show the relationship between the IMF Fiscal Index and debt ratios for the general government (left) and central government (right).
The machine description does not mention the scaling of the right y-axis in the left diagram (60 to 120) or the right y-axis in the right diagram (30 to 70).
The machine description does not mention the color coding of the lines and markers (blue and red) or their correspondence to the axes.
